name: x-ray-scan
title: X-Ray Scan
description: A glowing scanner bar sweeps across a device and reveals its white-line internals, with one part marked in red. A built-in phone stands in for the product; a host replaces the .xr-outside and .xr-inside layers with its own exterior and interior pictures.
useWhen: A hardware launch should show what is inside the device: the board, the battery, the chip that matters.
One internal part is the story, like a new chip or a bigger battery, and should be singled out in the brand color.
The reveal should read as a single clean scanner pass, left to right or top to bottom.
avoidWhen: The product should come apart into labelled layers: use exploded-view.
The product should be measured and annotated from the outside: use blueprint.
The subject should read as a printed poster rather than a device scan: use riso-print.
author: Remocn
